entities.summary: Li Hongxia is a field hockey player from China. She won a silver medal with the national women's hockey team at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing. Li Hongxia was a athletes & competitors from Liaoning (b. 1986-09-10, Liaoning). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
